mapper.insert: insert into br_declare_log (biz_type, biz_table, biz_id, biz_no, mirror_table, mirror_row_id, execute_type, uuid, sync_flag, create_time) values (#{bizType}, #{bizTable}, #{bizId}, #{bizNo}, #{mirrorTable}, #{mirrorRowId}, #{executeType}, #{uuid}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.select: select * from br_declare_log where sync_flag = '0' order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update br_declare_log set uuid = #{uuid}, result_status = #{resultStatus}, msg = #{msg}, result_time = #{resultTime}, sync_flag = '1' where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select biz_type as bizType, ifnull(result_status, 'PENDING') as resultStatus, count(*) as cnt from br_declare_log group by biz_type, ifnull(result_status, 'PENDING')
select * from br_declare_log where biz_table = #{bizTable} and biz_id = #{bizId} order by id
